registration.statement: One finite held incoming reaction channel and preparation compose with the complete finite support of distinct outgoing joint product-state words. Completed events in each retained state per complete positive event support force exact positive state shares, while each incoming/outgoing orientation remains a held relation. No scattering equation, cross-section law, angular continuum, probability amplitude, fitted potential or distribution is imported.
